content: UR e-series robots (incl. UR3e) DH parameters are ambiguous in terminology: UR's own docs and community sources disagree on whether they are 'standard' or 'modified' DH (Craig-style). UR provides official DH tables (link lengths a, offsets d, twist alpha) on developer.universal-robots.com; UR3e specific: LB=152mm, a2=244mm, a3=213mm, d4=131mm, d5=85mm, LTP=92mm. Because UR places a2/a3 along the same axis convention as other vendors differently, naively copying DH tables from generic tutorials produces wrong forward kinematics.
